Provider asks to reproduce option B shown on the proof; original brief requested A. This is a fidelity target proposal, not user approval of B or the unclear missing arm.

Historical Grok targets have different prompts/attempt histories; boss targets equal the reference image. Fresh matched runs are needed for generator ranking. Current files support historical-image improvement checks.
